rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by APA, NASP, Canadian Psychological Association, Wisconsin Psychological Association, Wisconsin School Psychologists Association; AMA/AOA Category 1 CME; psychology boards of other states where also licensed; graduate psychology courses at accredited institutions. Not pre-approved by the Department
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE needed before the first renewal (first two-year licensing period).
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation of all CE in case of audit.

topics.who: All psychologists: ethics, risk management, or jurisprudence

rules.notes: Reporting period Oct 1 of an odd year to Sep 30 of the next odd year. Publishing, first-time teaching and graduate coursework each count up to 20 hours.
rules.legal_basis: Wis. Admin. Code ch. Psy 4; Wis. Stat. ch. 455
